SD42-CP04.name: Kamen Rider Fourze Base States
SD42-CP04.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can summon a Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[When Braved] [LV2] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit to the Hand.

SD42-005.name: Decade Agito
SD42-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit. Also, if you control any Spirits with [Change], this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.

SD42-003.name: Decade Blade
SD42-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Nexus.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +4000 BP.

SD42-007.name: Decade Den-O
SD42-007.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 3 ([Red Core][White Core])]
During this battle, all your attacking Spirits gain +2000 BP. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace one of your Cost 6 or less "Kamen" family Spirits with this card in refreshed condition. If the Spirit is currently battling, continue the battle.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as White.

SD42-009.name: Decade Faiz
SD42-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit. Effects of the Spirit destroyed by this effect can't activate.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via comparing BP, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

SD42-001.name: Decade Hibiki
SD42-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning a "Kamen" family Spirit card, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Kamen" family Spirits gain +2000 BP.

SD42-014.name: Decade Illusion
SD42-014.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent]
Reveal three cards from your decktop. You can summon a "Decade"-named Spirit card among them, without paying the cost. Discard any remaining cards. However, (When Summoned) effects of Spirits can't activate.
Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Main effect.

[Main]
Draw two cards.

SD42-008.name: Decade Kabuto
SD42-008.effect:
When your Red Spirits are depleted/destroyed by opposing effects, you can summon this card from your Hand without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card, and destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.

SD42-011.name: Decade Kiva
SD42-011.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy every opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit.
After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When the opposing Life is reduced, the core from the Life is sent to the Trash instead of the Reserve.

SD42-004.name: Decade Kuuga
SD42-004.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 4 ([Red Core][Red Core][Red Core])]
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace one of your Cost 6 or less "Kamen" family Spirit with this card in refreshed condition. If the Spirit is currently battling, continue the battle.

SD42-015.name: Dimension Kick
SD42-015.effect:
While your "Decade"-named Spirit is attacking, this Magic card in your Hand is treated as Cost 2.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit. If you control any "Kamen" family Spirit, instead, destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit.

SD42-CP08.name: Kamen Rider Build RabbitTank Form
SD42-CP08.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 3 ([Red Core][Blue Core])]
Destroy an opposing braved Brave.
After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace it with a Cost 6 or less "Kamen" family Spirit you control in refreshed state.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a "Kamen" family Spirit card among them to your Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

SD42-006.name: Kamen Rider Decade
SD42-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step)
You can summon a Cost 4 to less "Kamen" family Spirit card from your Hand without paying the cost.

SD42-CP07.name: Kamen Rider Gaim Orange Arms
SD42-CP07.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.

SD42-CP02.name: Kamen Rider Ex-Aid Action Gamer Level 2
SD42-CP02.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
While [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, treat this Spirit as being at its highest LV.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit, and draw a card.

SD42-010.name: Kamen Rider Decade -Equip with Ride Booker-
SD42-010.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 6 ([Red Core][Red Core][Red Core])]
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 12000 BP. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace it with a Cost 6 or less "Kamen" family Spirit you control in refreshed condition. If it was in battle, the battle continues.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. For each "Kamen" family Spirit you control, increase the limit of this "BP Destruction effect" by +1000.

SD42-X01.name: Kamen Rider Decade Complete Form
SD42-X01.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 6 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. Among them, summon any number of "Kamen" family Spirit cards, without paying the cost. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3]
All your "Kamen" family Spirits gain +5000 BP.

SD42-CP03.name: Kamen Rider Drive Type Speed
SD42-CP03.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [True-Clash] (When Attacks)
Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP, and when only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via comparing BP with this Spirit, draw two cards.

SD42-CP01.name: Kamen Rider Ghost Ore Damashii
SD42-CP01.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return a "Kamen" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2]
When this Spirit is destroyed by an opposing effect, return it to the Hand.

SD42-CP05.name: Kamen Rider OOO TaToBa Combo
SD42-CP05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

SD42-CP10.name: Kamen Rider W CycloneCyclone
SD42-CP10.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 4 ([Red Core][Red Core][Green Core])]
Destroy an opposing Nexus. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace a Cost 6 or less "Kamen" family Spirit you control with this card in refreshed state. If it was in battle, the battle continues.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
If you control any "Joker"-named Spirit, put two cores from the Void to this Spirit.

SD42-CP09.name: Kamen Rider W JokerJoker
SD42-CP09.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 6 ([Red Core][Red Core][Red Core][Green Core])]
Destroy every opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace a Cost 6 or less "Kamen" family Spirit you control in refreshed state. If it was in battle, the battle continues.

[LV2][LV3]
While you control any "Cyclone"-named Spirit, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.

SD42-CP06.name: Kamen Rider Wizard Flame Style
SD42-CP06.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Reveal five cards from your decktop. Add a Spirit card among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Kamen" family Spirit attacks, destroy an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to the attacking Spirit's.

SD42-013.name: Machine Decader
SD42-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Kamen" family Spirits are blocked, draw a card.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit.

SD42-012.name: Ride Booker
SD42-012.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 4 or more]

[LV1] (When Summoned)
Reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Kamen" family Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[During Brave]
When switching places via your [Change], this Brave becomes Cost 0.
